raw_response:
I will keep the same wheat-maize rotation on all 2.6 mu. I farm small land, so I do not like fancy changes. I usually start from what worked before, then move a little. Wheat cannot be short of肥 at jointing, and maize cannot be short of肥 at big trumpet stage, so I will keep fertilizer a bit on the safe side. Spending some extra yuan on fertilizer hurts, but losing yield hurts more. We have well water, so I will use that where it matters most. For seed, I will follow what grows steady around here: improved wheat and hybrid maize. On my land, I will aim for a steady harvest, not chase the very highest yield.

decision.reasoning_summary: I will keep my full 2.6 mu in wheat-maize rotation because that is what I know and what works here. I will use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed, because people around me plant them and they give steadier harvests. I will put fertilizer a little heavy rather than too light: wheat will get enough nitrogen for spring growth, and maize will get enough at the big trumpet stage so it does not lose ear size. Since I have well irrigation, I will not let the key stages go dry, so wheat will get three waters and maize two. On this small area, I care most about a stable crop and keeping costs under control, so I will not chase extreme high-input farming, but I will not cut fertilizer or water too hard either.
